messages.text:
Hello,
I'd like to order a Harlo B30. It says customs and duty are prepaid. Does that mean UK VAT is prepaid? Ie the $939 price tag is the final price I pay?

Thank you,

Thomas
Handed to the team · Page wording on prepaid duty conflicts with the UK VAT rule; cannot confirm a la

Hi Thomas. The B30 lists at $899 USD, and that price is the unit only. Our UK line reads that orders to the UK may be subject to VAT and import duties on delivery, and those are the recipient's. We don't collect them at checkout. Shipping is separate and does show at checkout.

So the wording you're seeing doesn't match what I have. I've put it to Georges to confirm the exact UK landed position before you pay. He picks it up today at 10am ET and replies by email, so leave me your email address.
